name: wikiploy-rollout-example

scripts.--note--: You can remove all of this and just keep the deploy script.
scripts.build: npm run build-less && npm run build-js && node -e "console.log('Build done');"
scripts.rollout-dev: npm run build && npm run deploy-dev
scripts.rollout: npm run build && npm run deploy

--deps-note1--: You can remove most of this and keep eslint and wikiploy;
--deps-note2--: mocha and chai are for testing; browserify is for building JS; less is for building/merging CSS.
